name: 2nd Teen Story: X-mas
source: In this 2nd Teen Story created by CreaNyu, you'll be playing as a Vietnamese high school girl. It's the 24th of December and you're staying home alone with nothing to do. How will you make this Christmas memorable? Can you find true love in 4 hours before Christmas?
